trap-nonspeakable.notes: RIGOR (reported, not fixed - math-adjacent). (1) STALE q0 PIN, exactly the flagged string: 'at $q_0 = 1.109978595554181\ldots$ (50 dps)'. That is the OLD MUON value presented as 16 digits labelled '(50 dps)'. It is arithmetically correct as a CAL-2 solution, so this is a pin-currency defect, not a corrupt number - but the compute default is the proton pin 1.1099785827513808 (owner directive 2026-08-07) and the current muon pin is 1.10997859555733471. Proposed: replace with the proton pin and drop the '(50 dps)' label unless 50 digits are actually printed. (2) VERIFIED CORRECT (representation theory): C^10 = V_{(10)} + V_{(9,1)}; Lambda^2(A+B) = Lambda^2 A + A(x)B + Lambda^2 B with Lambda^2 of a line = 0; Lambda^2 of the standard rep of S_n is V_{(n-2,1,1)} of dimension C(n-1,2); for n = 10 that is V_{(8,1,1)}, dim 36; 9 + 36 = 45 = C(10,2). (3) VERIFIED CORRECT (numeric): 45.[3]_q = 136.966779 at the proton pin, matching the quoted 136.967. (4) ILL-DEFINED NOTATION: 'dim_q V_{(8,1,1)} = binom([9]_q, 2)_q' takes a q-binomial of a q-INTEGER; the q-binomial coefficient is defined on integer arguments and the q-dimension of a hook is given by the q-hook-length formula. It reduces to 36 at q = 1 as claimed, but the middle expression as written has no meaning at generic q. Proposed: give dim_q V_{(8,1,1)} by the q-hook formula. (5) TOKEN-SUBSTITUTION SWEEP DAMAGE, two sites in the Witness paragraph: 'Computational verification at q = 1 via the formal derivation and the dimension formula directly' - 'the formal derivation' is the placeholder standing in for a script name, so the witness cites nothing runnable; and 'canonical exact match to the expected 45.[3]_q' is 'canonical' substituted for 'numerical'. (6) 'canonical exact match ... with -0.05% residue' is self-contradictory as written: a match with a 0.05% residue is not exact.
